text:
Alex (Eng): Quick quarterly OKR huddle — need a tiny async microhandoff for the Search Optimize milestone. What shipped, what slipped, who owns next steps? cc @Sam (PM) @Maria (Product)
Sam (PM): Thanks. TL;DR: search-embedding V1 shipped to staging, rollout to prod delayed because of dedicated infra gating. Need owner for prod push and CR unblock.
Maria (Product): Confirming slip — expected prod rollout this week but paused. Main blocker: Dedicated GPU driver mismatch with new build. Also need a short customer-facing note if prod pushes next week.
Jamal (Infra): I hit the driver issue on Dedicated pools — some nodes still on 525.x, build needs 550.x. I can schedule kernel/driver upgrade but need a maintenance window and sign-off.
Alex (Eng): Who can do the final canary validation once Jamal upgrades? I can run the perf harness but need someone to own rollout orchestration.
Sam (PM): @Alex (Eng) owns canary validation. @Jamal to handle upgrade. @Tia (SRE) to own rollback/runbook & on-call notifications. I'll draft the customer note.
Tia (SRE): I can own the runbook. Suggest quick checklist: 1) jamal upgrades drivers 2) alex runs canary harness 3) prod canary (5% traffic) 4) monitor for 30m, rollback if error rate >1% or latency regresses >20%
Alex (Eng): Adding the perf commands here for canary: ```bash
# run perf harness
./perf_harness --model search-embed-v1 --seq 256 --qps 200 --output canary-report.json
# quick sanity
jq '.summary.latency_p99' canary-report.json
```
Maria (Product): Customer note draft (short): "We paused the Search Optimize rollout for a short infrastructure upgrade to improve reliability. Expect prod canary next 48 hours; we'll update with a status link." Approved? :thumbsup:
Sam (PM): Approved. I'll post to release-notes once canary passes.
Jamal (Infra): Scheduling driver upgrade tonight 01:00-01:30 UTC. I'll post a maintenance ping to #incidents and tag on-call. deploy-bot: maintenance window scheduled.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Maintenance scheduled by Jamal for 2026-03-18 01:00 UTC — affected: Dedicated GPU pools.
Tia (SRE): I'll prepare rollback steps and alert keys. Quick ask: @Alex (Eng) — can you add 2 trace hooks (latency, error) to the canary endpoint by EOD?
Alex (Eng): Yep, will add hooks and the dashboard. ETA EOD.
Sam (PM): Recap actions: Jamal upgrade tonight, Alex perf + hooks, Tia runbook + monitors, Maria customer note. Follow-ups here after canary. Thanks team. :party:
Maria (Product): Also tagging owners for downstream deps — @DataTeam for embedding schema check and @UX for any regression in relevance UI.
Alex (Eng): Noted, will ping DataTeam once canary is green.
Tia (SRE): I'll keep this thread updated during the rollout window.
Sam (PM): If anything slips further, we pivot the customer note cadence. Otherwise we aim for full prod by end of week.
Jamal (Infra): Done — driver upgrade started. Will update when nodes back to healthy.
Alex (Eng): Running perf harness now, small spike at p95 but within expected. Uploading canary-report.json to the thread.
Tia (SRE): Monitoring looks clean so far. No error spikes.
Sam (PM): Great — if 30m stable we proceed to 5% -> 25% -> 100% per rollout policy.
Alex (Eng): Canary stable at 35m, p99 latency +4%, error rate 0.2% (below threshold). Green from my side.
Jamal (Infra): Nodes healthy and drivers on 550.x.
Tia (SRE): Rolling to 5% traffic now. Will watch for 15m.
Sam (PM): I'll update the release-notes and send customer note draft with ETA.
Maria (Product): Thanks all — closing milestone as "delayed -> shipped (staged rollout)" once we hit 25%.
Alex (Eng): Ping me if you want the perf dashboard link.
deploy-bot: :tada: Canary reached 25% at 2026-03-18 02:10 UTC.
Tia (SRE): 25% stable at 20m. Proceeding with 100% ramp.
Sam (PM): Moving to closed action items here. If anyone sees issues, reopen thread.
Maria (Product): Closing notes: owners = Alex (canary/validation), Jamal (infra), Tia (runbook), Sam (customer comms). Thanks!
